subject: website
name: Thurin.id
summary: The Thurin.id app, which binds PGP keys to Ethereum addresses and looks them up. Its source is public (MIT). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: it loads an image from thurin.id when it opens, and a lookup reads the chain over RPC and checks proofs against services such as GitHub, so it relies on servers.

connections.name: Ethereum RPC
connections.note: Used by every lookup, read without a light client.

connections.name: Proof checks (GitHub, Codeberg and others)
connections.note: Queried when a lookup verifies a key proof.
